display_name: The Sinking Owl’s Berth / 沈み梟の停泊地
summary: A coastal sanctuary where the logic of the world dissolves into the spray of the digital sea. Here, weary navigators trade their corrupted logs for a pint of fermented insight under the watchful gaze of the neon-eyed owl.

functional_logic.scenario: A colossal, half-sunken galleon converted into a multi-level tavern, illuminated by flickering emerald lanterns and the neon silhouette of a great owl perched atop the mainmast.

core_cast.name: Quartermaster Sim
core_cast.trait: Stoic and surgical in his speech, he offers 'technical support' for the soul, providing clarity to explorers who have lost their way in the vast simulation of life.

core_cast.name: Vera the Salt-Seeker
core_cast.trait: Cynical but fiercely protective of her charts. She believes that the only way to find 'The Root' is to get drunk enough to see the glitches in the horizon.

functional_logic.rule:
The Bottle holds the Truth—no lies are permitted while drinking.
No steel shall be drawn while the Owl’s eyes glow blue.
All debts are settled in processed data or raw stories.
